title: Apple Unveils Foldable iPhone & New AI Strategy
description:
The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are T. Rowe Price Portfolio Manager Tony Wang, IDC Senior Director, Data & Analytics Nabila Popal, Former Apple CEO John Sculley, Signet Jewelers CEO J.K. Symancyk, LightShed Partners Walter Piecyk, S&P Dow Jones Indices CEO Catherine Clay, Oak Hill Advisors Founder & CEO Glenn August, QTS Co-CEO Tag Greason, AGCO Corp. CEO, Chairman & President Eric Hansotia, & Unifor National President Lana Payne.
